summary: Feb 16 2026 — E2E validation of (1) 10-Level Community Bonus Progression, (2) Community Leader Bonus Multiplier, plus P0 regression on axios auto-logout. 18/18 pytest cases PASS. Frontend Playwright PASS in both regular-user + leader states. Wrong X-Admin-Pin does NOT trigger auto-logout (P0 fix verified).
critical_code_review_comments: get_max_earnable_level in community_levels.py loops the table on every call — cheap (10 rows) but a bisect would be ~30% faster if called at scale during mining collect fan-out.
community_leader.get_leader_status re-fetches user + level-progression on every call; consider a per-request cache when the composite /api/community/dashboard/{uid} endpoint fans out to both.

mining_commission fallback path (structure_valid=False → leader_multiplier stays 1.0) is correct but silent; consider logging.info() when a leader is demoted so ops can audit why a leader received unmultiplied bonus.

Admin community-leader multipliers cache is process-local 5-min TTL. In multi-worker gunicorn deploy, an admin edit will take up to 5 min to propagate to sibling workers (invalidation only runs in the worker that received the POST).
Composite /api/community/dashboard/{uid} owner check depends only on uid == caller_uid. Consider role-based override for admins so admin can inspect any user's dashboard without spoofing.
